breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that having an adiabatic boundary (dT/dx=0) and a fixed temperature (T=350K) at the same location (x=0) is a contradiction. It resolved this by creating a physically consistent problem: it kept the fixed temperature at x=0 and applied the adiabatic (insulated) condition to the other side of the wall at x=L. This is one of the valid interpretations suggested by the ground truth to make the problem solvable.
